✅ Correct Answer: A — Driving straight through the pit lane without stopping

📖 Explanation:

On lap 57 of the 1993 European Grand Prix, Ayrton Senna drove into the pit lane intending to pit, but aborted the stop when his McLaren team was not out in the box.

Because Donington Park's pit lane bypassed the final hairpin and Formula 1 had no pit lane speed limits in 1993, this shortcut produced a lap time of 1:18.029, which stood as the official fastest lap of the race.
